# Doc comments: the run of `//` lines right above a declaration is its `doc` in the JSON
# interface, joined into one line. A blank line ends the run, so the module header and a
# comment followed by a blank line are no doc. An attribute line such as `@const` between
# the doc and the declaration is skipped. The text interface leaves docs out.
> --json interface app/main

Panics when the grid has no rows.", "location": {"file": "src/main.nra", "range": {"start": [14, 17], "end": [14, 25]}}}, {"name": "double", "kind": "function", "signature": "export function double(value: int): int", "doc": "Gives twice the value. The `@const` line between this doc and the function is skipped.", "location": {"file": "src/main.nra", "range": {"start": [20, 17], "end": [20, 23]}}}, {"name": "run", "kind": "function", "signature": "export function run(_args: Array<string>): int", "location": {"file": "src/main.nra", "range": {"start": [26, 17], "end": [26, 20]}}}]}
